title: Text joins the homepage feed
summary:
Text got a place beside images on the homepage, Llama 4 Scout joined the model list, and link previews stopped depending on JavaScript.

The homepage gained a toggle between image and text feeds, with a stream of generated responses and an editor for text. Projects now open on a Featured category with tabs for browsing; the same PR refreshed homepage layouts and controls.

Added Llama 4 Scout 17B as `llamascout` with a 4096-token output limit. `mistral` now maps to Mistral Small 3.1 24B, `qwen-qwq` to QWQ 32B, and the `deepseek-reasoning` model-list entry to DeepSeek-R1 Distill Qwen 32B rather than the full DeepSeek R1. The duplicate `qwen-reasoning` mapping was removed, and Gemini model-list entries were commented out.

Open Graph and Twitter Card metadata moved into the initial HTML, letting link previews read the site title, description, and banner without running JavaScript. The React Helmet dependency was removed.
